name: How much does rental unit make-ready cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does rental unit make-ready cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of rental unit make-ready services depends on several factors, including the size of the unit, its current condition, and the extent of work needed. Projects involving deep cleaning and minor touch-ups will be less expensive than those requiring extensive repairs, painting, or material replacements. Simply Construction provides a detailed, itemized quote after an on-site assessment, ensuring transparency and no hidden fees for our clients. We focus on cost-effective solutions without compromising quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Make-ready costs vary based on unit size, condition, and scope of work; a detailed quote is provided after assessment.
